title: 第18章 真的误会啊第19章 杀手
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
“我家里房子小没地方住啊，对了你不是菲菲男朋友吗？你就住在酒店吧我刚才看的你从酒店出来，你把把菲菲带到你房间就是了，你们两个年轻人晚上正好研究造人计划。”
不过那菲菲舅妈则嘻嘻一笑，说出了这番话来。
陈锋一愣，顿时无语了，心想这是什么舅妈啊，说的什么屁话呢。而且她怎么放心自己，要自己带她外甥女去酒店，她就不怕自己是坏人吗。
不过陈锋想到自己这么帅，或许也明白了，或许真的自己不是坏人吧，有这么帅的坏人吗。
无奈之下，他只好将许菲菲抱起来，将她背在了自己背上，打算让她去自己的酒店房间住一晚再说。
毕竟菲菲都醉成这个样子了，她自己已经没办法行动了，学校这个时间点也关了门，除了去酒店还能去哪。
背着许菲菲刚刚走到酒店门口的时候，菲菲似乎醒了一点、她笑嘻嘻的用手勾着陈锋的脖子，将性感的嘴巴凑到了陈锋的耳边结结巴巴的道：“大叔，你带我去哪里啊？不会是……酒店开房吧，大……大叔你好坏啊！你不会要对……对人家做羞羞的事情吧。”、
许菲菲已经完全喝醉了，说话胡言乱语，不过她声音很大，偏偏酒店人来人往的很多人都听到了，他们都惊讶的看着背着许菲菲的陈锋，对着他们指指点点。有的女人更是看着陈锋的眼神里充满了鄙夷，似乎陈锋是流氓一样，是诱骗小姑娘的老流氓。
看到周围的人对自己指指点点，听到菲菲的话，陈锋尴尬死了，他真想找个地缝钻下去。不过他还是解释道：“菲菲，你真的喝醉了，我把你送到房间里让你休息，我就换个房间住的，菲菲我不是你想的那种人，你知道的。”
他一边说一边用手推开菲菲的脸，让她距离自己远一点，毕竟被这么多人看到，他真的尴尬。
不过就在此刻，陈锋忽然看到围观人群里有一个女人，对方正惊讶的看着自己，而这个女人不是别人，赫然是林仙儿。
原来刚才林仙儿在烧掉了和陈锋的合影照片后，躺在床上的她也因为陈锋的事情睡不着，她觉得自己为了弟弟的事情要嫁给自己并不喜欢的王少，她觉得很对不起陈锋，毕竟陈锋是她初恋男友啊，他们是有深厚的感情的。
躺在床上熬了半天后她感觉肚子饿，就打算下楼买点东西。
不过她万万没想到碰到了陈锋，还看到陈锋背着一个喝醉酒的女孩子，和那个女孩子打情骂俏。
一时间，她惊呆了。
而此刻，许菲菲压根不知道旁边有李林仙儿存在，她依旧醉醺醺的用手勾着陈锋的脖子，说道：“大叔，晚上你要对我温柔一点啊，人家还是c呢，嘻嘻。”
说完，她竟然在陈锋脸上亲了一口。
听到许菲菲的话，看到陈锋脸上口红印，林仙儿惊呆了，泪水滚滚落下。
原来她还觉得对不起陈锋，但是现在看的陈锋把一个如花似玉的喝醉酒背到酒店，还和人家打情骂俏，似乎还要做那种事。
一时间，林仙儿心都碎了。

“原来他从来没将我放在心上，原来他早有了别的女人。”
林仙儿心想，感觉心里很难受。
“仙儿，不是你想的那样，我……”
陈锋一阵无语，他不知道该怎么解释了，真是倒霉。
“不用说了，从今天开始我们没任何关系了，你要和哪个女孩子好和你自由，和我说对不起做什么？再说你别忘记了，我是王少的未婚妻。”
林仙儿深吸一口气，她在留下这句话后气冲冲的跑了，她用手捂着脸跑了，很快就消失的无影无踪。
现场就剩下一脸无语的陈锋，和看热闹的人。
而陈锋更是气的不行，这下真是黄泥巴掉裤裆，不是屎也是屎了。
回到酒店自己的房间将许菲菲丢在了床上，陈锋气的不行，真想给许菲菲两巴掌。
不过他的手举在半空也放下了，毕竟这也不能怪人家菲菲啊，人家也不知道会发生这种事啊，人家也不知道会碰到林仙儿，只能算倒霉。
“陈锋，大叔，我好喜欢你。”
不过就在陈锋打算给许菲菲盖被子的时候，躺在床上的许菲菲忽然开口喊道。
许菲菲穿着花裙子，不过她裙子下一双美丽的套着肉色丝袜大长腿，丰腴的大腿灯光下充满了诱惑力。
不过陈锋没有心情观看，他烦得很。
“喜欢我，你到底喜欢我什么，我改还不好吗？”
陈锋将菲菲的裙子拉了下来遮住大腿，他也很是生气。就是因为许菲菲，导致他和初恋女友发生了误会，对方现在又说喜欢他，他也想搞清楚菲菲喜欢他什么。
“喜欢你帅，你会打架，而且你……像我过世的爸……爸，我好想你。”
躺在床上紧闭双眼的许菲菲哽咽道，陈锋看到两行眼泪顺着许菲菲的眼眶里滑落下来，她虽然在睡觉不过流泪了。
“原来是缺少父爱啊，可怜。”
陈锋似乎明白了什么，他好像听小姑妈说过，许菲菲父亲在她很小的时候就过世了，如今她和是妈妈继父在一起住的。

从小失去了父亲的孩子，自然是缺少安全感的，而且可能会喜欢年纪比较大的成年男性，这样来以弥补缺少的父爱，这是有科学根据的。

content_en:
"My house is small and there is no place to live. By the way, aren't you Feifei's boyfriend? You can stay in the hotel. I just saw you coming out of the hotel. Just take Feifei to your room. You two young people will be studying the plan to create humans at night."
But Aunt Feifei smiled and said these words.
Chen Feng was stunned and immediately speechless. He thought to himself, what kind of aunt is this and what kind of nonsense are she talking about. And how could she trust herself? If she wanted to take her niece to the hotel, wouldn't she be afraid that she would be a bad person?
But Chen Feng thought that he was so handsome, and maybe he understood that maybe he was not a bad guy. Is there such a handsome bad guy?
In desperation, he had no choice but to pick up Xu Feifei and carry her on his back, planning to let her stay in his hotel room for one night.
After all, Feifei was so drunk that she could no longer move. The school was closed at this time, so where else could she go but to the hotel.
Just when she was carrying Xu Feifei and walked to the door of the hotel, Feifei seemed to wake up a little. She put her hands on Chen Feng's neck with a smile, put her sexy mouth to Chen Feng's ear and stammered: "Uncle, where are you taking me? It's not... to book a room in the hotel, uncle... uncle, you are so good! You don't want to do shameful things to... to others."
Xu Feifei was completely drunk and was talking nonsense, but her voice was very loud, so many people coming and going in the hotel heard her. They all looked at Chen Feng in surprise, who was carrying Xu Feifei on his back, pointing at them. Some women looked at Chen Feng with disdain in their eyes, as if Chen Feng was a gangster, an old gangster who deceived little girls.
Seeing the people around him pointing fingers at him and hearing Feifei's words, Chen Feng was so embarrassed that he really wanted to find a crack in the ground and burrow down. However, he still explained: "Feifei, you are really drunk. I sent you to the room to let you rest, and then I moved to another room. Feifei, I am not the kind of person you think, you know."
As he spoke, he pushed Feifei's face away with his hand to keep her away from him. After all, he was really embarrassed to be seen by so many people.
But at this moment, Chen Feng suddenly saw a woman in the crowd of onlookers, who was looking at him in surprise, and this woman was none other than Lin Xian'er.
It turned out that after Lin Xian'er burned the photos with Chen Feng just now, she couldn't sleep because of Chen Feng's affairs while lying in bed. She felt that she had to marry Mr. Wang, whom she didn't like, because of her brother's affairs. She felt very sorry for Chen Feng. After all, Chen Feng was her first boyfriend, and they had a deep relationship.
After lying in bed for a long time, she felt hungry and planned to go downstairs to buy something.
But she never expected to meet Chen Feng and see Chen Feng carrying a drunk girl on his back and flirting with the girl.
For a moment, she was stunned.
At this moment, Xu Feifei didn't even know that Li Linxian'er existed next to her. She still hung her hands around Chen Feng's neck drunkenly and said, "Uncle, you have to be gentler to me tonight. I'm still a c-girl, hehe."
After saying that, she actually kissed Chen Feng on the face.
Hearing Xu Feifei's words and seeing the lipstick mark on Chen Feng's face, Lin Xianer was stunned and tears rolled down her face.
Originally, she felt sorry for Chen Feng, but now that she saw Chen Feng carrying a drunk girl to the hotel and flirting with her, it seemed that he would do that kind of thing again.
For a moment, Lin Xianer's heart was broken.
"It turns out he never cared about me. It turns out he already had another woman."
Lin Xian'er thought to herself, feeling very uncomfortable.
"Xian'er, it's not what you think, I..."
Chen Feng was speechless for a while. He didn't know how to explain it. It was really unlucky.
"Needless to say, we have nothing to do with each other from today on. Which girl do you want to be with?"What are you doing to say sorry to me? Besides, don’t forget, I am Mr. Wang’s fiancée. "
Lin Xianer took a deep breath. After leaving these words, she ran away angrily. She covered her face with her hands and ran away, quickly disappearing without a trace.
The only ones left at the scene were a speechless Chen Feng and the onlookers.
And Chen Feng was even more angry. Now his crotch was covered in yellow mud, and it was either shit or shit.
When he returned to his room in the hotel, he threw Xu Feifei on the bed. Chen Feng was so angry that he really wanted to slap Xu Feifei twice.
However, he put his hand down in the air. After all, this can't be blamed on Feifei. They didn't know that this kind of thing would happen. They didn't know that they would meet Lin Xian'er, so it can only be considered unlucky.
"Chen Feng, uncle, I like you so much. "
But just when Chen Feng was about to cover Xu Feifei with a quilt, Xu Feifei, who was lying on the bed, suddenly shouted.
Xu Feifei was wearing a floral skirt, but under her skirt she had a pair of beautiful long legs in flesh-colored stockings, and her plump thighs were full of temptation under the light.
But Chen Feng was not in the mood to watch, he was very annoyed.
"If you like me, what do you like about me? Isn't it better for me to change it? "
Chen Feng pulled down Feifei's skirt to cover her thighs, and he was also very angry. It was because of Xu Feifei that he had a misunderstanding with his first girlfriend, who now said she liked him, and he also wanted to find out what Feifei liked about him.
"I like that you are handsome, you can fight, and you... look like my deceased dad... Dad, I miss you so much. "
Lying on the bed with her eyes tightly closed, Xu Feifei choked and choked. Chen Feng saw two lines of tears falling down Xu Feifei's eyes. Although she was sleeping, she was still crying.
"It turns out it's a lack of father's love, it's pitiful. "
Chen Feng seemed to understand something. He seemed to have heard from his little aunt that Xu Feifei's father passed away when she was very young, and now she lives with her mother's stepfather.
Children who have lost their father since childhood naturally lack a sense of security and may like older adult men to make up for the lack of fatherly love. This is based on science.
